$comment: Reproducible definition of the staged scale experiment dataset. The payloads themselves are not committed; this manifest plus ingestion/scale/capture.ts regenerates them byte-for-byte.

capture.envelopeDescription: Yorkshire and adjacent Northern England: a single contiguous British National Grid box covering West/North/South/East Yorkshire and parts of Lancashire, Durham and Nottinghamshire.

composition.note: Not cherry-picked. Every record intersecting the envelope was taken in ListEntry order up to each layer quota, so the sample includes unnamed, poorly located and mundane entries as well as well-known sites. Scheduled monuments (3,234), parks (183), battlefields (7), wrecks (3) and World Heritage Sites (4) are taken in full because the region genuinely contains no more; only listed buildings are capped, at 21,569 of the 40,743 available.

tierOrder.note: Tier N is the first N entries of `order`. Prefixes are nested (1k subset of 2.5k subset of 5k subset of 10k subset of 25k) and each preserves the designation mix available at that depth. The first 5,000 entries are byte-identical to those used for the decision-equivalence oracles, so those proofs continue to refer to the same corpus; the larger tiers extend the order rather than rebuild it.
tierOrder.processingOrder: Tier membership is defined by the stratified prefix above; within a run records are processed in the adapter's natural layer-by-layer order, which is how the NHLE FeatureServer actually returns them and therefore how a production import would see them.

cache.note: Regenerated by ingestion/scale/capture.ts, not committed. Records are grouped into the layer blocks the NHLE adapter's file mode expects; `order` above defines tier membership.
